blocks.title: Krishi-Decision Support System (Krishi-DSS / ADSS)
blocks.summary: To provide a comprehensive geospatial decision support system integrating satellite remote sensing, weather models, soil health maps, and groundwater levels to empower farmers, crop insurance assessment, and agricultural policy planning.

rows: Digital Agriculture Mission Umbrella Outlay (₹2,817 Cr)
Total outlay ₹2,817 Cr (Centre ₹1,940 Cr, State ₹877 Cr) for 2024-2027.
Integrates remote sensing, soil health GIS, weather, and groundwater.
Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers' Welfare
Department of Agriculture and Farmers' Welfare (DA&FW)
₹2,817 Crore (Total Digital Agriculture Mission outlay; Central Share: ₹1,940 Crore, State Share: ₹877 Crore).
Central Sector component within Digital Agriculture Mission umbrella.
Department of Agriculture & Farmers' Welfare in collaboration with ISRO (Department of Space) and Mahalanobis National Crop Forecast Centre (MNCFC).

items: **Target Beneficiaries:** Indian farmers, state agriculture departments, crop insurance agencies (PMFBY), and agricultural research institutions.
**Eligibility Criteria:** All registered farmers and agricultural stakeholders across India.
Digital Crop Estimation: Uses multi-temporal satellite imagery to assess crop area and health.
Drought and Moisture Monitoring: Real-time soil moisture and weather data integration for early drought warnings.

AgriStack Core Registries: Directly integrates with the three foundational pillars of AgriStack — (1) Farmers' Registry (unique Farmer ID), (2) Geo-referenced Village Maps, and (3) Crop Sown Registry.
Pest and Disease Surveillance: GIS-based pest prediction to enable targeted advisory to farmers.
Core Trap: Krishi-DSS is NOT a standalone private tech tool; it is a foundational public digital infrastructure under the ₹2,817 Cr Digital Agriculture Mission (2024).
AgriStack Registries: Built on 3 core registries: Farmers' Registry (Farmer ID), Geo-referenced Village Maps, and Crop Sown Registry.
Technology partner: Jointly developed with ISRO / MNCFC.
